village_herald_stylized.prompt: In-game screenshot of a stylized co-op multiplayer video game, third-person camera behind a player character. Art style: stylized 3D like a modern indie friend-slop game, clay-like caricature characters with big noses, chunky exaggerated proportions and simple readable shapes; smooth hand-painted textures with low detail, soft toon-ish lighting, saturated but earthy palette. Clearly a game, NOT photoreal, NOT low poly. Scene: a humble 14th-century peasant camp in a forest clearing: a few patched canvas tents, campfire with a cooking pot, woodpile with an axe in a stump, small cabbage patch. A pompous herald on a horse in a fleur-de-lis tabard has just ridden in, blowing a trumpet; four goofy peasant players in mismatched clothes look at him in dread. Autumn afternoon light. Minimal HUD: small health icons in the corner.
